key_findings: EarningsInOne corpus (arXiv:2606.29734) provides clean proof of two-speed PEAD: numeric surprise decays by next open, qualitative ECT text remains tradeable +1 day. Direct H174 upgrade path.
TSFMs (arXiv:2607.05291) offer negligible improvement over Log-HAR for RV forecasting — keep VRP = VIX - RV22d simple for H448.
FinDPO continuous scoring (arXiv:2507.18417) could improve H174 threshold calibration — Sharpe 2.0 with 5bp costs, 11% accuracy gain.
H478 (OB filter on H411 Var B 4.825) is the single highest-priority backtest — analogous to H344 which doubled H198 Sharpe.
H417 baseline was inflated in CLAUDE.local.md (claims 5.855 but corrected OOS is 0.383). Real H-series record is H411 Var B 4.825.
